title: [S06] Isolate acquisition from graph writes with a complete capture sink
prerequisites: DEF-45 (S05): readable text and typed contacts - DONE

entry_conditions.requirement: Prevent legacy postprocessing and callbacks from publishing unreviewed observations while retaining reusable acquisition code
entry_conditions.scope_description: Complete capture-only graph sink via existing graph_service injection; trace constructor/execute/postprocess/flush, direct callbacks, batches, registry kwargs and task creation

scope.enabled_local_acquisition: Must not default to live graph, require Neo4j credentials, or connect on import
scope.preserved_lineage: Captured unreviewed operations and input/source lineage; unsupported methods fail explicitly
scope.no_broad_replacement: No deletion of historical graph data or broad replacement of graph storage

implementation_steps: 1. Trace all graph methods used by first enabled scraper/enricher path
2. Use existing graph_service injection seam; implement capture-only with explicit unsupported-method failure
3. Ensure enabled callers inject capture sink, cannot fall back to live graph by default
4. Return captured candidate operations as unreviewed; retain input/source lineage
5. Remove accepted-graph credentials from local acquisition path; verify import-time behavior

acceptance_fixtures.name: more_than_auto_flush_no_writes
acceptance_fixtures.description: More than auto-flush batch size produces no live graph writes

acceptance_fixtures.name: callback_exception_captured
acceptance_fixtures.description: Direct discovery callback and exception after partial scan remain captured

acceptance_fixtures.name: unsupported_fails_explicitly
acceptance_fixtures.description: Unsupported graph method fails explicitly rather than delegating

acceptance_fixtures.name: scraper_no_credentials
acceptance_fixtures.description: Scraper runs with no Neo4j service or credentials

blast_targets.envelope: Enricher constructor/execute/postprocess/flush, GraphRepository batching, registry kwargs forwarding, callback closures and task construction
blast_targets.root_discovery: Use B02 verified command/native-route manifest to capture roots, callers, downstream sinks, exports/configuration consumers
blast_targets.before_mutation: Capture index freshness, coverage, changed-file/symbol/test set
blast_targets.after_change: Refresh safely, rerun analysis, compare predicted vs actual tracked/untracked drift

excluded: Live Neo4j writes in capture mode
graph_policy: Isolated worktree index only. Serial pip3r commands with --no-auto-index, explicit drift analysis. Python dynamic edge gaps marked UNKNOWN. New CaptureGraphRepository is pure Python, no Neo4j traces.

verification_approach.mutation_testing: Inject each captured operation defect, confirm test fails, restore with cmp
real_cases: Batch > 5 items auto-flushes without Neo4j writes
Exception after partial scan captured with full lineage
Custom query() method raises NotImplementedError explicitly
No Neo4j credentials or connection required to run
verification_approach.independent_review: Separate reviewer reads code, tests, traces public caller to changed behavior; reviewer identity or self-review limitation recorded

evidence_requirements.reproduction: Expected behavior and actual commands with base/head/package/configuration hashes
evidence_requirements.blast_analysis: Pre-edit and post-edit Blast, drift comparison, scoped Hunt and Doctor/test/contract results
evidence_requirements.blocking_findings: Introduced findings fixed before review acceptance; preexisting findings explicitly classified
evidence_requirements.deliverable_proof: Callable/testable through entrypoint; docs/examples agree with actual output; required cases PASS

recovery: Revert via git reset --hard <base_sha>; feature disable: use live graph factory, not capture_only=True; preserves unrelated work, input lineage, immutable evidence
